// copied from planning-tool/backend/src/services/authority/organization-navigation.ts lines 1-58
/**
 * Resolve the single organization-entry label exposed by the authenticated
 * session projection.  This is display metadata, not an authorization grant;
 * the organization tree and every target decision remain server-authorized
 * independently.
 */

export type OrganizationNavigationLabel =
  | 'My Team'
  | 'My Department'
  | 'My Unit'
  | 'My Area'
  | 'My Group'
  | 'My Organization';

const UNIT_TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, OrganizationNavigationLabel> = {
  TEAM: 'My Team',
  DEPARTMENT: 'My Department',
  SUB_UNIT: 'My Unit',
  AREA: 'My Area',
  EXPERT_GROUP: 'My Group',
};

const ORGANIZATION_MANAGER_ROLES = new Set([
  'ORGANIZATION_MANAGER',
  'MANAGEMENT',
  'HIGHER_MANAGEMENT',
]);

const APPLICATION_ADMIN_ROLES = new Set([
  'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
  'SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR',
  'PLANNING_ADMIN',
  'PLANNING_ADMINISTRATOR',
]);

/**
 * Match the reference-main display rule while keeping the decision in the
 * server session projection.  An unassigned employee deliberately receives
 * `My Unit`: the label identifies the one organization entry and does not
 * imply that a unit binding exists.
 */
export function resolveOrganizationNavigationLabel(
  roles: readonly string[],
  homeOrganizationType: string | null | undefined,
): OrganizationNavigationLabel {
  if (roles.some((role) => ORGANIZATION_MANAGER_ROLES.has(role))) {
    return 'My Organization';
  }
  if (roles.includes('DEPARTMENT_MANAGER')) return 'My Department';
  if (roles.includes('TEAM_LEADER')) return 'My Team';
  if (roles.some((role) => APPLICATION_ADMIN_ROLES.has(role))) {
    return 'My Organization';
  }
  return homeOrganizationType
    ? UNIT_TYPE_LABELS[homeOrganizationType] ?? 'My Unit'
    : 'My Unit';
}
